summary: Retain Imersite powder research beyond level three in the reviewed Factorio 2.1.21 K2/K2SO profile.
details: An exact-engine compatibility guard omitted the existing level-four continuation on Factorio 2.1.21 with Krastorio2 2.1.3 and Krastorio2-spaced-out 2.0.13. A distinct exact profile now selects the existing science policy and continuation without widening recipe permissions or route certificates.

The finite levels 1–3 and their identities remain. Native creation and reload preserve an 8% completed-level-four powder bonus, the separate 10% crystal bonus, and level five queued with 42% progress.
In the exact retained profile, two unmodified native crushers demonstrate output after reload: 300 ore produces 324 powder and 324 sand with the earned bonus, versus 300 of each without research.
The fixture supplies ingredients and energy. This does not establish natural acquisition, published-predecessor upgrades, other K2 routes or joined release acceptance.
